description: Versioned, consented, daily-level feature schema for Navi research exports. Raw journal text, raw audio, transcripts, names, emails, OAuth tokens, and raw Firebase UIDs are excluded.
time_zone: UTC date unless a future study protocol defines local-day handling.
identifiability: coded; participant_code is a non-reversible backend hash prefix, not a raw account identifier.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Feature summary date.

fields.name: schema_name
fields.description: Stable schema family name.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Semantic version of this research feature record contract.

fields.name: generated_at
fields.description: UTC time when the feature record was generated or enriched.

fields.name: record_type
fields.description: Record class. Current value is daily_feature_summary.

fields.name: source_system
fields.description: System that generated the record, usually navi_flutter_app.

fields.name: participant_code
fields.description: Backend-added coded participant identifier. Raw Firebase UID is excluded.

fields.name: consent_scope
fields.description: Consent scope under which the record may be used.

fields.name: consent_version
fields.description: Version of in-app consent text accepted by the participant.

fields.name: privacy_policy_version
fields.description: Version of privacy policy accepted by the participant.

fields.name: terms_version
fields.description: Version of terms accepted by the participant.

fields.name: data_classification
fields.description: Data handling class. Current value is coded_research_feature.

fields.name: identifiability
fields.description: Identifiability level. Current value is coded.

fields.name: raw_text_included
fields.description: False for this schema; raw journal text is not included.

fields.name: raw_audio_included
fields.description: False for this schema; raw audio files are not included.

fields.name: research_use_allowed
fields.description: True only when optional research sharing is enabled at upload time.

fields.name: sentiment_today
fields.description: Daily average journal sentiment score.

fields.name: rolling_mean_7
fields.description: Seven-day rolling mean of sentiment_today.

fields.name: volatility_7
fields.description: Seven-day rolling sentiment volatility.

fields.name: momentum_7
fields.description: Seven-day sentiment momentum.

fields.name: z_score
fields.description: Deviation from recent baseline sentiment.

fields.name: is_anomalous
fields.description: Whether the day is anomalous relative to baseline.

fields.name: day_of_week
fields.description: Zero-indexed day of week where 0 is Monday.

fields.name: Next_day_delta
fields.description: Next-day sentiment delta when available. Used for retrospective model training only.

fields.name: sleep_hours
fields.description: Daily sleep duration from connected health source.

fields.name: sleep_efficiency
fields.description: Sleep efficiency percentage from connected health source.

fields.name: resting_hr
fields.description: Resting heart rate from connected health source.

fields.name: hrv_rmssd
fields.description: Heart-rate-variability RMSSD from connected health source.

fields.name: recovery_score
fields.description: Provider recovery/readiness score when available.

fields.name: strain
fields.description: Provider strain/activity load score when available.

fields.name: beacon_sample_count
fields.description: Count of Navi Beacon telemetry samples on the date.

fields.name: beacon_hr_avg
fields.description: Average heart rate from Navi Beacon samples.

fields.name: beacon_hr_min
fields.description: Minimum heart rate from Navi Beacon samples.

fields.name: beacon_hr_max
fields.description: Maximum heart rate from Navi Beacon samples.

fields.name: beacon_temp_c_avg
fields.description: Average temperature in Celsius from Navi Beacon samples.

fields.name: beacon_lux_avg
fields.description: Average ambient light exposure from Navi Beacon samples.

fields.name: beacon_motion_avg
fields.description: Average motion magnitude from Navi Beacon accelerometer samples.

fields.name: beacon_battery_avg
fields.description: Average Navi Beacon battery percentage.

fields.name: beacon_activity_still_ratio
fields.description: Share of Navi Beacon samples classified as still.

fields.name: beacon_activity_walking_ratio
fields.description: Share of Navi Beacon samples classified as walking.

fields.name: beacon_activity_running_ratio
fields.description: Share of Navi Beacon samples classified as running.

fields.name: beacon_activity_restless_ratio
fields.description: Share of Navi Beacon samples classified as restless.

fields.name: audio_session_count
fields.description: Count of audio reflection sessions on the date.

fields.name: audio_total_seconds
fields.description: Total duration of audio reflections on the date.

fields.name: audio_negative_ratio
fields.description: Share of labeled audio sessions with negative labels.

fields.name: audio_positive_ratio
fields.description: Share of labeled audio sessions with positive labels.

fields.name: audio_anxious_ratio
fields.description: Share of labeled audio sessions with anxious labels.

fields.name: audio_calm_ratio
fields.description: Share of labeled audio sessions with calm/neutral labels.

fields.name: audio_training_count
fields.description: Count of audio sessions explicitly marked for model training.

fields.name: keyboard_session_count
fields.description: Count of in-app typing rhythm sessions.

fields.name: keyboard_event_count
fields.description: Aggregate count of typing events. Individual keys are not stored.

fields.name: keyboard_chars_estimated
fields.description: Estimated character count. Typed content is not stored.

fields.name: keyboard_backspace_count
fields.description: Aggregate backspace/correction count.

fields.name: keyboard_correction_rate
fields.description: Aggregate correction rate.

fields.name: keyboard_pause_mean_ms
fields.description: Mean pause duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: keyboard_pause_std_ms
fields.description: Standard deviation of pause duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: keyboard_burst_count
fields.description: Aggregate count of typing bursts.

fields.name: keyboard_typing_speed_cpm
fields.description: Estimated typing speed in characters per minute.

fields.name: keyboard_late_night_ratio
fields.description: Share of typing sessions recorded during late-night hours.

fields.name: keyboard_platform_web
fields.description: Share of typing sessions from web.

fields.name: keyboard_platform_mobile
fields.description: Share of typing sessions from mobile platforms.

fields.name: keyboard_platform_desktop
fields.description: Share of typing sessions from desktop platforms.

fields.name: missing_journal
fields.description: 1 when journal-derived data are missing.

fields.name: missing_biometrics
fields.description: 1 when all biometric data are missing.

fields.name: missing_audio
fields.description: 1 when audio-derived data are missing.

fields.name: missing_keyboard
fields.description: 1 when typing-rhythm data are missing.

fields.name: missing_sleep
fields.description: 1 when sleep_hours is missing.

fields.name: missing_hrv
fields.description: 1 when hrv_rmssd is missing.

fields.name: missing_recovery
fields.description: 1 when recovery_score is missing.
